description: EVERY SHOT THE PANEL IS HOLDING, by name, with its size, its address, how many marks it carries and whether it is cropped. Taking a picture puts it on the shelf by itself, so this is also the answer to «what did the tester just capture». Names come from the path («checkout», «checkout-2»), because a person can hold those in their head and a timestamp they cannot. Read-only.
